agent_explanation: Close encounter of two massive bodies causes integration failure with large dt. From step 19 to 22 distance falls from >1.1 to 0.46 (inside softening length 0.3 scale), potential deepens from -562 to -1665 and kinetic spikes to 2080. Adaptive substeps (23->30) insufficient at dt=0.0333, causing ~140 energy drop (E0 555.5, allowed 74.9) vs 2% tolerance. Reducing dt to 0.005 with identical G/masses/initial conditions eliminates violation, confirming timestep resolution is causal.
